sourceTitle: Rinnai N-series residential with pump SENSEI installation and operation manual (RUR199i, RUR160i, RUR199e, RUR160e), section 5.6
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not try to light the water heater, do not touch an electrical switch, and do not use a phone in the building. Leave and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off power at the breaker and shut the gas supply before any panel comes off. Gas pressure, the burner, the gas valve, venting and the control board belong to a licensed technician or the manufacturer's technical support.
displayPattern: Diagnostic code on a Rinnai N-series SENSEI tankless water heater with pump (RUR199i, RUR160i, RUR199e, RUR160e). Section 5.6 shows how to recall the last nine codes.
meaning: High outgoing water temperature. The heater shuts down because the water is too hot.
diySteps: Turn the water heater off. Do not keep restarting a high-temperature shutdown
Technician: section 5.6 says to confirm the fan motor is functioning and to replace the gas valve assembly. The fan check is marked for a trained professional
proAdvice: Code 16 is a safety shutdown for outgoing water that is too hot. Call a licensed technician or Rinnai Customer Care at 1-800-621-9419.
